description: Repeat-use search monitor: run a query and get only the results that are NEW since your last poll of that query. First call stores a baseline (first_poll=true, new_count=0); later calls return new_results only. Pass reset=true to rebuild the baseline. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/websearch/topicwatch

reset.description: Rebuild the baseline instead of diffing
